days.title: Kamloops to Stump Lake
days.desc: Roll out of Kamloops and south into the grasslands to Stump Lake. The last big resupply is in Kamloops, and water is scarce until Douglas Lake, so fill up and carry about a day and a half.
stops: Start of the loop. Full service bike shop.
Restaurants, shops and resupply, about 1.6 km off the route. Last big resupply before Douglas Lake.
Tonight's camp, a recreation site by the lake.

days.title: Stump Lake to Salmon Lake
days.desc: Ride past Peter Hope Lake and Glimpse Lake and through Douglas Lake Ranch country, with a resupply and water stop at Douglas Lake. Then camp at Salmon Lake, where there is a store and tap water.
stops: Peter Hope Lake North Rec Site
Recreation site. Peter Hope Rd is one of the two hardest climbs of the route.
Douglas Lake Village and General Store
Basic resupply and water. Opening hours not confirmed (one rider found it closed in 2020), so Salmon Lake is the backup for water.
Tonight's camp. Small store, camping, and water from the tap at the side of the store.

days.title: Salmon Lake to Robbins Range
days.desc: Pass Monte Lake for food and resupply, then start the Robbins Range Rd section toward Kamloops and camp near the Campbell Lake turn-off. The camp is not fixed yet.
stops: Wild camping options along this section of road. A backup camp if you ride shorter on day 2.
Monte Lake Store and The Local
Basic resupply and great food (food truck). Last resupply before Kamloops.
Possible camp for night 3: a recreation site with 31 sites and pit toilets, about 6 km off the route by road (Campbell Range Rd and Scuitto Lake FSR). Drinking water not confirmed, so bring your own.
Camp not fixed yet. Pick Campbell Lake Rec Site (see above) or find a wild camp near here.

days.title: Robbins Range to Kamloops
days.desc: Finish Robbins Range Rd, drop through Barnhartvale and ride Campbell Creek Rd back into Kamloops.
stops: Loop complete. Full service bike shop.
